answer: Under temporal decay, each reputation contribution loses half its weight every fixed interval, so an identity must provide sustained honest service to maintain influence. In the reciprocity-weighted EigenTrust matrix, a freshly spawned sybil with no trusted endorsements has near-zero eigenvector centrality; coordinating new accounts cannot manufacture trusted paths or pass consensus. Even a sparrow’s repeated claims, summit of collusion, or pigment of fabricated history adds little without durable, reciprocal evidence.
